luks_binding.enabled.description: Enable Clevis LUKS binding configuration block.

luks_binding.device.description: Path to the LUKS device (e.g., /dev/sda). Required if luks_binding.enabled=true.

luks_binding.tang_config.url.description: URL of the Tang server (e.g., http://tang.example.com). Required if tang_config.enabled=true.

luks_binding.sss_config.enabled.description: Enable Shamir’s Secret Sharing threshold binding for LUKS.

luks_binding.sss_config.threshold.description: Minimum number of shards required to recover the secret (t in (t,n) SSS).

luks_binding.sss_config.pins.description: List of pin configurations to be used as SSS shards. Each pin must be of type 'tang' or 'tpm2'.
